title: Trial Key Golems
description: Gives Trial Keys a brand new look based on Minecraft Dungeons
body:
# Trial Key Golems
## By Opliz

While vanilla Trial Keys look good, I wanted to point out that there already was an established key entity in the Minecraft universe.

This Resource Pack changes the look and sounds of Trial Keys to be like the Key Golems from Minecraft Dungeons.

# Details

- The textures for the Key Golems and the model itself, were made by me.

- The vault sounds are a fusion of the vanilla sound and Key Golem SFX from Minecraft Dungeons, both owned by Mojang.

**This project is not approved or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.**
